messages:
lina (People Ops): Quick Q — we have an engineer on a 12-night client engagement in Lisbon (May 3–14). Team proposed a corporate short-term apartment (single invoice from host) instead of nightly hotels. Is the reimbursement flow the same as hotel? do we still give per diem for meals? any special receipt rules?

jamal (Finance): We can reimburse, but need an itemized invoice showing nightly rate + any cleaning/service fees and proof of payment. Accommodation is reimbursed on actuals up to the usual cap. Per diem for meals is separate. :thinking:

sasha (Travel Ops): A few operational bits: if vendor bills directly to Redwood via AP, the employee should NOT submit the accommodation line in Expensify. If the employee paid and got refunded by AP later, submit with the vendor invoice + bank/card proof. For corporate apartment specifically, we need the invoice to show the address and guest name.

people-ops-bot: Policy snippet — "Accommodation: itemized receipt required. Meals: per diem applies unless meals are included in lodging invoice; if included, per diem will be prorated."

miguel (Engineering): FYI our card declined at booking portal so we asked vendor to invoice company. Do I need to do anything besides adding the trip to Concur/Expensify?

jamal (Finance): If vendor invoiced Redwood and AP paid, Miguel — please confirm vendor invoice number and travel dates in the Concur trip record and set accommodation amount to $0 personal claim. Attach the Concur/AP reference in the trip notes.

lina (People Ops): One nuance: if the apartment includes complimentary breakfast or three meals/week, we reduce per diem for those days proportionally. Example: full-board days -> per diem 0; breakfast-only days -> reduce per diem by 20%. I'll DM the exact prorate table. :thumbsup:

sasha (Travel Ops): Also run tax/VAT handling by Jamal — EU invoices often have VAT shown; Finance can decide whether employee claims VAT refund or company claims it. If the invoice is to Redwood, Finance handles VAT recovery.

miguel (Engineering): Great, thanks. I have the vendor invoice PDF and the AP reference (INV-2026-0453). I'll add both to Concur and mark accommodation $0. Anything else?

jamal (Finance): That's perfect — include the line items if meals are bundled. If vendor only gives a lump-sum, ask them for a breakdown or we may need a short vendor attestation email.

lina (People Ops): Thanks all. Action items: Miguel attach vendor PDF + AP ref to Concur; Sasha confirm vendor attestation process if needed; Jamal confirm VAT handling. I’ll update the travel FAQ with the apartment example this afternoon.
